description: This file defines API route handlers for a branding compliance backend system. It uses FastAPI to implement endpoints for creating, deleting, uploading assets, triggering analysis, fetching status/results, fixing assets, and downloading reports related to branding asset compliance jobs. The file integrates with several service classes and data models to orchestrate the workflow.

classes.name: CreateJobRequest
classes.description: Request model for creating a new job, including optional owner, title, description.

classes.name: CreateJobResponse
classes.description: Response model containing the created job's ID.

classes.name: StatusResponse
classes.description: Model representing the status and progress details of a job.

classes.name: FixAssetRequest
classes.description: Request model for fixing a single asset, with optional strategy.

classes.name: BatchFixRequest
classes.description: Request model for batch fixing assets with issues.

methods.name: create_job(data: CreateJobRequest, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Creates a new job, generates a UUID, and initializes in the StateStore.

methods.name: delete_job(job_id: str, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Removes a job's workspace and state, with 404 handling if not found.

methods.name: None _save_upload_to(path: Path, file: UploadFile)
methods.description: Helper to save uploaded files to a specified path.

methods.name: upload_assets_zip(job_id: str, file: UploadFile = File(...), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Handles ZIP upload, extraction, and updates job status.

methods.name: upload_old_brand(job_id: str, file: UploadFile = File(...), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Uploads a reference image of the old brand to a specific analysis directory.

methods.name: upload_new_brand(job_id: str, file: UploadFile = File(...), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Uploads a reference image of the new brand for overlay fixing.

methods.name: analyze_job(job_id: str, background: BackgroundTasks, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Triggers background analysis and preview generation, updates job status.

methods.name: get_status(job_id: str, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Returns current progress and status details for a job.

methods.name: get_results(job_id: str, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Lists assets and issues associated with the job.

methods.name: get_asset_preview( job_id: str, asset_id: str, view: Literal["original", "overlay", "fixed"] = Query("original", description="Preview type"), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store), )
methods.description: Serves preview images in different views for a specific asset.

methods.name: fix_single_asset(job_id: str, asset_id: str, req: FixAssetRequest, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Automatically fixes a specific asset using a stub strategy.

methods.name: batch_fix(job_id: str, req: BatchFixRequest, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Performs automatic fixes on all assets with issues in a batch.

methods.name: download_artifacts( job_id: str, type: Literal["zip", "report", "both"] = Query("zip", description="Artifact type to download"), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store), )
methods.description: Creates and serves report artifacts (zip or report) for download.
